body.x: iDiction has introduced a 3D Modeling system, which measures sizes of the body through a smartphone, in 'MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT'(BOOTH # 52843) of CES 2019 EUREKA PARK held in Las Vegas, USA for four days starting from January 8 (Tue).

3D Modeling is a system that can easily measure body sizes through smartphone for 3D modeling. Through the data of measured body sizes, it complements the existing online shopping for apparel which had a higher risk of buying a wrong outfit.

This enhances the satisfaction rate and level convenience of the customer in choosing clothes that fit for their bodies. Also, it maximizes company profit by reducing the risk of production and exchange and return transaction at the same time.

An official from iDiction said, “We have been researching for solving the problem between supplier and customers who have various risks like sizes when buying fit apparel online. Based on this problem, we have developed this technology.”
